svg.title: Someone is home in there
svg.desc: A person stands in the rain at night, upright and calm, meeting your eyes. Set into their chest is a real window with a wooden frame and a sill. Through it, a warmly lit room: a lamp, two cups on a table, a plant, and someone sitting at home, turned toward their own light. The same warmth is caught in the standing person's eyes. Around them on the wet street, other people — a child, an elder, neighbors — each carry a small lit window. The words read: Someone is home in there. Leave them warmer than you found them. You are in there too.
